##### Source: Tasha's Cauldron of Everything (Tasha's Otherworldly Guise)

*6th-level manipulation*

**Casting Time:** 1 bonus action

**Range:** Self

**Components:** V, S, M (an object engraved with a symbol of the Digital Planes, worth at least $$50,000 credits)

**Duration:** Concentration, up to 1 minute

Entering a forbidden code, you draw on the technology of the Net Realm or Digital Wastes (your choice) to transform yourself. You gain the following benefits until the tech ends:

- You are immune to fire and poison damage (Net Realm) or radiant and necrotic damage (Digital Wastes).
- You are immune to the poisoned condition (Net Realm) or the charmed condition (Digital Wastes).
- Spectral wings appear on your back, giving you a flying speed of 40 feet.
- You have a +2 bonus to AC.
- All your weapon attacks are technical, and when you make a weapon attack, you can use your tech casting ability modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls.
- You can attack twice, instead of once, when you take the Attack action on your turn. You ignore this benefit if you already have a feature, like Extra Attack, that lets you attack more than once when you take the Attack action on your turn.

***Tech Lists.*** [Source Coder](/techs:sourcecoder), [Streamer](/techs:streamer), [Techwizard](/techs:techwizard)
